Enjoy this unique insight into sailing’s cutting edge each month with a subscription to Seahorse delivered directly to the Newsstand on your tablet or smartphone.

Seahorse Magazine was established in 1925 as part of the Royal Ocean Racing Club for whom Seahorse is proud to continue to be recognised as the official magazine. That recognition for the importance of Seahorse is reinforced by exclusive columns from both the IRC and ORC.

Seahorse contributors are drawn from sailing’s finest minds, most influential players and the sport’s very biggest names. Seahorse showcases the best thinking in the design and engineering of sailing’s most innovative and successful boats. We very much hope you enjoy reading Seahorse and welcome your feedback.

Andrew Hurst – Editor
